snippet.title: Vital Shell - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Vital Shell launches January 7, 2026!

Wishlist now on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3741860/Vital_Shell/

Music: ​ ⁨‪@pizzahotline_   Ice Planet

https://linktr.ee/vitalshellgame

Vital Shell is a single player twin-stick shooter that puts you in control of mechs inspired by classic fantasy archetypes. Unlock powerful synergies with unique weapons, traits, and abilities as you take on increasingly challenging waves of enemies in a shattered realm.
